sections.title: Where to wait
sections.content: A *megálló* is a stop, an *állomás* is a station and a *pályaudvar* is a big railway station. Ask where it is with *Hol van…?* and answer with the words you know: *itt*, *ott*, *közel*, *messze*, *innen*. *Innen* means "from here": *Innen messze van* (it is far from here). To say you wait at a stop, use *-ban*: *a megállóban várok*.

sections.title: Where is it?
rows: The station is far from here.

items.english: The railway station is far from here.
I am waiting at the stop.

sections.content: English says "at the stop", Hungarian says "in the stop": *a megállóban várok*. Do not leave the ending out: *a megálló várok* is not a sentence.
